review: 701.6b-1, 701.6b-2, 701.6b-3: the not_countered variants were labelled does_not_fire, but no refund ever happens, so 701.6b has no does_not_fire branch; relabelled them other (costs stay paid whether or not the spell or ability is countered).

scenarios.title: A countered spell does not resolve and goes to its owner's graveyard

setup.notes: Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant.

decisions: A casts Grizzly Bears, tapping both Forests.
B responds by casting Counterspell targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Counterspell resolves.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: countered
variants.expected: Counterspell resolves and Grizzly Bears is countered: it never reaches the battlefield and is in A's graveyard. Counterspell is in B's graveyard. The stack is empty.

variants.label: not_countered
variants.delta: B holds Counterspell and does not cast it; both players pass and Grizzly Bears resolves.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears resolves and is on A's battlefield. Counterspell is still in B's hand. A's graveyard is empty.

scenarios.title: A countered activated ability is removed from the stack and its effect does not occur
decisions: A activates Prodigal Sorcerer, tapping it as the cost, targeting player B.
B responds by casting Stifle targeting Prodigal Sorcerer's activated ability, tapping Island.
Both players pass; Stifle resolves.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: countered
variants.expected: Stifle counters the ability: it leaves the stack without resolving and B's life stays at 20. Prodigal Sorcerer stays tapped on A's battlefield. Stifle is in B's graveyard.

variants.label: not_countered
variants.delta: B does not cast Stifle; both players pass.
variants.expected: The ability resolves and deals 1 damage to B, whose life is 19. Prodigal Sorcerer is tapped on A's battlefield. Stifle is still in B's hand.

scenarios.title: Mana spent on a countered spell is not refunded

setup.notes: Shock costs one mana; the second Mountain stays untapped.

decisions: A casts Shock targeting player B, tapping the first Mountain.
B responds by casting Counterspell targeting Shock, tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Counterspell resolves.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: countered
variants.expected: Shock is countered and goes to A's graveyard; B's life stays 20. The first Mountain stays tapped (A's mana is not refunded) and the second Mountain is untapped.

variants.label: not_countered
variants.delta: B does not cast Counterspell and passes.
variants.expected: Shock resolves and deals 2 damage to B, whose life is 18. The first Mountain is tapped as in the base variant.

scenarios.title: Permanents sacrificed to cast a countered spell stay sacrificed
decisions: A casts Fireblast targeting player B, paying its alternative cost by sacrificing both Mountains.
B responds by casting Counterspell targeting Fireblast, tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Counterspell resolves.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: countered
variants.expected: Fireblast is countered and goes to A's graveyard together with both sacrificed Mountains (they do not return to the battlefield). B's life stays 20.

variants.label: not_countered
variants.delta: B does not cast Counterspell and passes.
variants.expected: Fireblast resolves and deals 4 damage to B, whose life is 16. Both Mountains are in A's graveyard as in the base variant.

scenarios.title: A creature sacrificed as the cost of a countered ability stays sacrificed
decisions: A activates Mogg Fanatic, sacrificing it as the cost, targeting player B.
B responds by casting Stifle targeting the Mogg Fanatic ability, tapping Island.
Both players pass; Stifle resolves.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: countered
variants.expected: The ability is countered: B's life stays 20. Mogg Fanatic stays in A's graveyard and does not return to the battlefield.

variants.label: not_countered
variants.delta: B does not cast Stifle and passes.
variants.expected: The ability resolves and deals 1 damage to B, whose life is 19. Mogg Fanatic is in A's graveyard.
